method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 沿走廊走向卧室，推开半掩的门，看见自己躺在床上、Tommy 蜷缩在身旁。
facts.anchor: She is lying in the middle of the bed and Tommy is curled next to her.

facts.fact: 她看到自己已经死了：眼睛睁着、嘴部松弛，耳边枕头上有一团深色血迹。
facts.anchor: There is a dark inkblot of blood on her pillow behind her ear.

facts.fact: Tommy 背对着她蜷成胎儿姿势，穿着旧棒球服，号码 7 在月光下泛白。
facts.anchor: the number 7 glowing whitely in the moonlight

facts.fact: 屋外传来近处的猫头鹰叫声，声音被拖慢，像老式空袭警报缓缓拉响。
facts.anchor: It’s beginning to hoot from somewhere very close, except its voice has been slowed to a crawl.

facts.fact: Tommy 转身变成 Julian，手里握着 Ed 的木锥——那把 Tommy 从店里偷走、用来杀害四个人的木锥。
facts.anchor: The one Tommy stole from the shop and used to murder four people.

facts.fact: Julian 凑到她面前超过她身高、对着她的脸冷冷呼吸后，Hattie 睁眼发现自己站在前廊、双手紧抓冰冷栏杆。
facts.anchor: She’s standing on her front porch.

facts.fact: 她进屋在炉子前蹲下，冷得发抖，用拨火棍拨炭并添了几块橡木。
facts.anchor: By the time she’s kneeling before the stove she’s shaking so hard she can barely hold the poker long enough to stir the coals and add a few pieces of oak.

facts.fact: 她回想起睡前已断定屋外没人，把那看成影子加上过度担心的产物。
facts.anchor: By the time she brushed her teeth and climbed into bed she’d settled on no.

facts.fact: 她裹着毯子坐回椅子，意识到那场噩梦源于纯粹的内疚。
